overview: At home you copied that one sentence into the commonplace book and ruled a line under it, so the author's words stayed apart from your own. You wrote no answer under the rule. You thought no kinship.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Copied the sentence, ruled the line, and wrote nothing under it.

important_dates.meaning: A rule, and nothing under it

summary: Copied the sentence and ruled a line under it
